depiction.composition: single outlined document with inset magnifier cutting into bottom-right edge

near_misses.better: magnifying glass or desk lamp icon

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a document page combined with a magnifying glass, universally understood as searching for a file or closely reviewing/auditing paperwork. It fits common admin, legal, financial, and work tasks where locating or inspecting a document is the point. At tiny sizes the cut corner can briefly suggest a SIM card, so it works best when paired with file or paperwork tasks.
